d:
This super hit love song of 2002 about love having no reason was written by Pravin Bhardwaj, music by Anand Raaj Anand and sung by Alka Yagnik and Babul Supriyo. Starring Bipasha Basu and Dino Morea, with a story line by Mahesh Bhatt, Gunaah - A Tale of Forbidden Love is a crime thriller.
Credits:
Song Name - Hamne Tumko Dil Ye De Diya
Movie - Gunaah
Singer - Alka Yagnik; Babul Supriyo
Composer - Anand Raj Anand
Lyricists - Pravin Bhardwaj
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
